payload.title: revenue widget shows this month's total
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('revenue-total')
Expected: "$128,400"
Received: "$114,900"

note: A specific wrong dollar figure reads like a calculation bug, but the chart library animates the counter upward over roughly 800ms and the assertion fires mid-tween. Retried-and-passed plus a low, steady historical rate (never a spike, always near the same count) confirm timing, not a bad total — a real calculation bug would show the same wrong final value every run; this one differs every time it fails.
